content: Midiyaame Dere Bolla Dendida Ola
GODAY Muses,
«Midiyaame asay Isra7eele asaa bolla gaththida qohoza gishshas neni Midiyaame asaa halo kessa; hessa ooththidaappe guye neni hayqqana» gides.
Hessa gishshas Musey derezas, «Midiyaame asay GODAA bolla kase ooththida qohoza gishshas intte halo kessanaas olas giigettite.
Isra7eele asaa zarkkefe zarkkefe issi issi shii attumas dooridi gede olas yeddite» gides.
Hessa gishshas Isra7eele zarkketappe issi issi shii as kessi immiin 12,000 asi olas gixettidi giigettides.

Museykka issi issi zarkkefe issi issi shii asi qeese El7ezeere naa Finihaase kaaleththon olas yeddides; Finihaasikka geeshshasozappe dumma miishshatanne olas denththeththiza zayeta ba kushen oykkidi bides.
Isttika GODAY Muse azazida mala Midiyaame asaa olidi attumasaa mulera wodhida.
Hayqqidayta giddon Midiyaame kawo ichchashati Eeway, Ereqeemey, Xuurey, Uureynne Ereba7ey deettes; Bi7oore naa Balaamekka mashshan wodhida.
Isra7eele asay Midiyaame maccassatanne guuththa nayta di7idi istta mehetanne istta aqota ubbaa pitti ekkides.
Istti diza katamatanne istti diza gutata ubbaa taman xuuggida.
Istta asaa, mehaanne di7ida miish ubbaa ekkida.
Yordaanoose shaafappe he pinththa ginara diza Mo7aabe demban dunkaani uttida Musekko, qeese El7ezeerekkonne kumeththa Isra7eele maabaraakko ehida.
Musey qeese El7ezeereynne maabaraa kaaleththizayti ola asaa mokkanaas gede kezida.
Musey gidikko olaasoppe haa simmiza ola asaa azaziza shaalaqata bollanne mato halaqata bolla hanqettides.
Izikka isttas, «Hayssa maccas ubbaa aazas wodhontta shemppora paxa aggidetii?
Nuni kase Pe7ooren dishin hayti Balaame zore ekkidi Isra7eele asay ba GODAAPPE haakkana malanne boshan wurana mala ooththiday istta gidettennee!
Hessa gishshas attuma nayta ubbaanne addera gayttida maccassata ubbaa wodhite.
Gido attiin addera gaytti erontta geela7ota wodhontta inttes ashshite.

«Intte garsan as wodhidaadey woykko aha bochchida asi wurikka laappun gallas gakkanaas asi dizasoppe harason gam7o; heedzdzanththa gallassinne laappunththa gallas inttenanne intte di7i ehida maccassata geeshshite.
Hessaththoka ay may7o woykko galbafe, deysha iskefenne miththafe oosettida miish ubbaa geeshshite» gides.
Qeese El7ezeerey olappe simmida attumasaas, «GODAY Muses immida wogati hayssafe kaallizayta;
worqqay, biray, xarqimalay, biratay, qorqoroynne irsaasey,
hessaththoka tamay istta qohonttayti tama giddora aadhdhidi geeyanaas bessees; tama dandayontta ay miishshika kase wodhdhida wogaa mala geeshos giigettida haaththan geeshshite.
Intte intte may7o laappunththa gallas meeccite; hessafe guye intte geesh gidiza gishshas simmidi kase intte dunkaani dizaso gelanaas dandayeeta» gides.
Di7i Ehidayssa Gisheteth
GODAY Muses hizgides,
«Neni qeese El7ezeereynne deraa kaaleththiza korapinnetara gididi di7etti yida asaanne mehaa qoodite.
Nam7u kessi shaakkidi baggaa olaso bida wottadaratas attoyssa hankko maabaraas immite.
Wottadarata gishaappe di7ettida asaappe, miizatappe, haretappe dorsatappenne deyshatappe ichchashu xeetappe issino taas GODAAS dumma imota histti shaakkite.
He intte taas GODAAS shaakkidayssa ta gishaza qeese El7ezeeres immite.
Hinko maabaras imettida gishaappe, asaappe, miizaappe, dorsatappe, deyshatappenne haretappe ichchash tammaafe issino Gaytoteththa Dunkaanen alaafeteththan ooththiza Lewetas immite.»
Museynne El7ezeerey GODAY istta azazidayssa ubbaa ooththida.
Wottadarati banttas ekkishin attidayssi, 675,000 dorsatanne deyshata,
Laappun tammanne nam7u shii miizata,
Usuppun tammanne issi shii hareta,
Heedzdzu tammanne nam7u shii adde erontta geela7ota.
Di7etti yidayssafe baggay oletti yidaytas imettides; hessika 337,500 dorsata.
Isttafe 675 GODAAS dumma imota geetetti shaakettidayta.
Miizati 36,000; isttafe GODAAS dumma imota gidi shaakettidayti laappun tammanne nam7a.
Hareti 30,500; isttafe GODAAS dumma imota gidi shaakettidayti usuppuna.
Adde erontta geela7oti 16,000; isttafe GODAAS dumma imota gididi shaakettidayti heedzdzu tammanne nam7a.
Hessa gishshas Musey GODAY iza azazida mala GODAAS dumma imota histti shaakkidayssa qeese El7ezeeres immides.
Hankko Isra7eele Maabaraa gishay olas kiitettida wottadarata gishara issi gina.
Hessika 337,500 dorsatanne deyshata,
Heedzdzu tammanne usuppun shii miizata,
Heedzdzu tammu shiyanne ichchashu xeetu hareta,
tammanne usuppun shii adde erontta geela7ota.
Hessa gishshas Musey ichchash tammaafe issino GODAY iza azazida mala Gaytoteththa Dunkaanen alaafeteththan ooththiza Lewe zarkketas immides.
Hessafe guye ola asaa azazizayti shaalaqatinne mato halaqati Museeko shiiqidi,
«Nuni ne oosanchchati nuuppe garsara azazettiza wottadarata ubbaa qoodidos; isttafe issoyka paccibeenna;

hessa gishshas nuni issoy issoy ekkida worqqa aleqota, toho gimota, kushe sagayota, biradhdhe midigata, hayththa gutichchata, qoodhen aadhdhiza maccifarata ubbaa nu nagaraa wursanaas GODAAS yarsho immanaas ekki yidos» gida.
Museynne qeese El7ezeerey worqqafe oosettida alleqota ubbaa ekkida.
Shalaqatappenne mato halaqatappe ekkidi Museynne qeese El7ezeerey GODAAS imota histti shiishshida worqqa alleqoti 16,750 saqile gidides.
Garsara diza wottadarati gidikko ba di7idayssa baas baas ekki bida.
Hessa gishshas Museynne qeese El7ezeerey shalaqatappenne mato halaqatappe ekkida worqqa alleqota GODAA sinththan Isra7eele deraa hassa7isana mala gede Gaytoteththa dunkaanezaakko ekki bida.

footnotes.text: Maccifara geetettizayssi beni wode maccassati seelos qoodhen aaththi may7iza birappe, worqqafe, xarqimalappenne dumma dumma miishshatappe oosettida alleqo miishsha.
16,750 Saqile gizayssi kilon meezaanettishin 200 kilo giraame gidana.
